requirements.title: Hardened production promotion gate A-K exists
requirements.objective: A capability may reach production only when eleven independent gates pass
requirements.description: A single failed gate blocks promotion.
acceptance_criteria: Every gate result is computed from the record, never asserted
A conforming fixture is promoted (positive control POSCTRL-A)
Twenty negative cases each fail a named gate

verification.observed_result: sps2/capability/promotion_gates.py evaluates eleven gates A to K per capability. All five candidates were evaluated. validate-p4.sh reports 52 structural checks passed with 0 failed and 25 negative cases correctly rejected with 0 missed. Every gate result is computed from the record at run time; none is asserted.

requirements.title: Promotion gate is enforced, not advisory
requirements.objective: Each candidate is evaluated independently and stored results match a fresh run
requirements.description: Stored assessments must never drift from computed ones.
acceptance_criteria: validate-p4.sh recomputes every assessment and compares
A stale stored assessment is detected as STALE_ASSESSMENT

verification.observed_result: The gate is enforced, not advisory. A capability cannot reach ACTIVE while any gate blocks it: check_p3.py and validate-p4.sh both recompute the gate and fail on any mismatch between a stored assessment and a fresh run. Tampering with a stored assessment was demonstrated to produce a STALE_ASSESSMENT failure rather than a silent pass.
